explanation: France beat Brazil 3-0 at the Stade de France to win the World Cup for the first time, as hosts. Emmanuel Petit added the third goal in stoppage time.

Thierry Henry, Youri Djorkaeff and Emmanuel Petit did not score two headed goals in the 1998 final; Petit scored France's third goal.
France beat Brazil 3-0 in the 1998 final at the Stade de France, winning the World Cup for the first time, as hosts.
Emmanuel Petit scored France's third goal of the 1998 final in stoppage time.
